maps.title: Relief (Natural Earth)
maps.description: Light shaded-relief map with terrain colours, lakes, rivers and ocean depth. Sharp up to about a whole country on screen.

maps.title: Satellite (NASA Blue Marble)
maps.description: Cloud-free satellite image of the whole earth at 500 m per pixel, with shaded terrain and ocean depth. Shows valleys, lakes, forests and large towns.
maps.license: NASA imagery, not subject to copyright (credit: NASA Earth Observatory)

details.title: Sentinel-2: Europe (overview)
details.description: Cloud-free Sentinel-2 satellite image (year 2021 combined), drawn over Blue Marble inside this area. Sharp down to about 100 m per pixel: towns, lakes, rivers, motorways and large airports.
details.license: CC BY 4.0: (c) ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium. Sea: NASA Blue Marble (not subject to copyright).
